crusadecraft.news.partition: %1$s is divided on its ruler's death: %2$s founds %3$s.
crusadecraft.news.crisis: Succession crisis in %1$s: %2$s rises up, takes %3$s and claims the throne.
crusadecraft.feast.tip: Hold a feast: councillors, mayors and invited neighbours enjoy it, and it brings prestige. For half a day, the people of the register gather at court.
crusadecraft.feast.mourning: The court is in mourning: no feast.
crusadecraft.feast.already: The feast is already in full swing.
crusadecraft.feast.war: There is no feasting in wartime.
crusadecraft.feast.cooldown: Too soon: next feast possible in %s day(s).
crusadecraft.feast.no_gold: The treasury cannot pay for the feast.
crusadecraft.feast.state.feasting: The feast is in full swing
crusadecraft.toast.feast.title: Feast
crusadecraft.toast.mourning.title: Mourning
crusadecraft.replique.fete.1: To the health of the realm!
crusadecraft.replique.fete.2: We haven't seen such a table in years.
crusadecraft.replique.fete.3: A little more of that wine, if you please.
crusadecraft.replique.fete.4: Let the minstrels play until dawn!
crusadecraft.replique.fete.avare.1: All that gold, gone in one evening…
crusadecraft.replique.fete.avare.2: I'll keep the leftovers for tomorrow.
crusadecraft.replique.fete.genereux.2: Take this dish to the gates, for the poor.
crusadecraft.replique.deuil.2: The court will never be the same.
crusadecraft.replique.deuil.3: Life will have to go on.
crusadecraft.replique.deuil.compatissant: If I can help, just say so.
Take all the time you need.
crusadecraft.replique.guerre.1: The news from the front is not good.
crusadecraft.replique.guerre.2: They say the enemy marches on us.
crusadecraft.replique.guerre.brave.1: Give me a blade and I'll go.
crusadecraft.replique.guerre.lache.1: I'll stay behind the walls, thank you.
crusadecraft.replique.guerre.lache.2: Is there no way to negotiate?
crusadecraft.replique.cour.1: A fine day to serve the crown.
crusadecraft.replique.cour.2: Have you heard what they say at the market?
crusadecraft.replique.cour.pieux.1: I prayed for you this morning.
crusadecraft.replique.cour.pieux.2: The chapel could use a new roof.
crusadecraft.person.appearance.tip: Comes Alive's appearance editor (face, hair, clothes), on the villager who embodies this person. You must be within 48 blocks of them.
crusadecraft.person.appearance.far: Get closer to %s (under 48 blocks) to change their appearance.
crusadecraft.tree.title: Tree
crusadecraft.tree.help: Drag to move · scroll to zoom · click to choose
crusadecraft.tree.mca.tip: Opens Comes Alive's family tree on this person (their house is registered there first).
crusadecraft.tree.open.tip: The whole house as a tree, generation by generation, with couples and children.
